Theme choices in onboarding now apply immediately, just like Appearance settings.
Browse content preloads during onboarding so new users arrive with content already loading or ready.
Added a quick library CTA to manga details with save, status selection, and sharing controls.
Sharing from manga details now opens the recommendation preview so you can add a note before sharing.
Quick actions now use shorter tracking labels and theme-matched selector corners.
Fixed reader-completed chapters updating library tracker progress in both local and AniList library modes.
Handled decimal chapters and unnumbered extras more carefully when deciding tracker progress.
Centered chapter download progress indicators in the same action slot as the download icons.
Tankobun is an unofficial manga reader and is not affiliated with AniList.
Thanks to AniList for making its API available to users and community apps.

AniList is an anime and manga database, tracking, and social site. It does not host, upload, share, sell, or provide manga, chapters, or scanlations. Tankobun accesses AniList metadata through the AniList API; account sync uses user authorization.
Sources and extensions are third-party. Tankobun only works with compatible extension formats and local user configuration.
